title: Refund Payment on a Resident's Own Cancellation of an Entrance Fee Agreement Before Occupancy
content:
The refund owed when a resident's own cancellation has ended an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy is paid by Larkspur in one payment.

## Release condition

A refund on a resident's own cancellation before occupancy is not paid until the agreement stands in cancelled status and its ledger carries the processing fee retained on that cancellation.

Put as a reading of the agreement record: both of the following must hold at the time of payment, and the refund waits while either does not.

| Agreement record | Ledger of the agreement | Refund may be paid |
|---|---|---|
| Cancelled status | Carries the processing fee retained on that cancellation | Yes |
| Cancelled status | No processing fee entry for that cancellation | No |
| Any status other than cancelled | Any | No |

## Scope

This refund rule covers only a cancellation signed by the resident or the resident's financial agent. A cancellation because death, illness or injury prevents occupancy retains no processing fee, and its refund, to the estate after a death, stays governed by the general pre-occupancy cancellation terms of the agreement, outside this rule.

## Time limit

The refund is paid no later than the plan's pre-occupancy refund period, in calendar days, after the cancellation.

## Paying the refund

The payment is made with the tool `pay_pre_occupancy_refund_45806fa1`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. It enters one refund payment entry for the amount given on the agreement's ledger, dated today, paid by refund check to the payee recorded on the agreement and mailed to the address on file; the refundable balance falls by that amount. The tool computes nothing and checks no status of its own.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the cancelled or rescinded Entrance Fee Agreement being refunded, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `refund_amount` | The refund paid | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** On success: `status` ("refund_paid"); `entrance_agreement_id`; `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the refund payment entry); `refund_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `payment_reference` (the refund check number issued by this call, which the customer can quote when the check arrives); `payment_method` ("check"); `refund_payee_type` (resident or estate, as recorded on the agreement); `refundable_balance` (the balance left on the agreement, USD, 2 decimal places).
